text_blocks.snippet: Opsumit (macitentan) is a prescription medication used to treat pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH). It can cause a range of common and serious side effects.
More detailed safety and prescribing information is available through the Official Opsumit Website or the FDA Drug Label.
